records.literal_text:
Kiraṇāvali (Guṇa°) by Udayana, + Guṇaśiromaṇi by Mathura[^rā]nātha, + Co.² Guṇa-
dīdhitirahasya. Unf.                n.d.:210:16:D.
annotations: An ink slash stands in the left margin before the entry, at approx. [430,3155,95,130].
A small interlinear insertion, read as 'rā' or 'ā', is written above the 'Mathura-' part of the name. It may overwrite an earlier letter. It is rendered here as [^rā].
A small mark appears above the first '+'.
The '2' after 'Co.' is superscript.
'Unf.' is left unexpanded.
No shelfmark is written.

relationships.evidence: Same work family as the list on the facing fol. 47. The relation is not marked.

uncertainties: The reading of the interlinear insertion above 'Mathura' is uncertain.
The final vowel of 'Kiraṇāvali' is uncertain.

block_disposition.explanation: Note with a probable but unsecured attachment to the following entry.
Interlinear correction within the author name of r004.

page_annotations: Faint diagonal and 's/'-like strokes at the right of the text area are judged probable show-through and were not transcribed.
There is a grey smudge in the lower left margin.
Shelfmark fragments at the right edge belong to fol. 47 and were excluded.
Mirrored show-through from fol. 46 was not transcribed.
unresolved_relationships: The governing heading for the ditto dashes in r002 is not identified.
It is uncertain whether 'MS. No. not entered.' refers to the Kiraṇāvali entry.

coverage.finding: The pencil '46b.' (superscript 'b') is at the top left. The record is adequate.

The cancelled line is represented. In the native tile, a thin strike line runs from the shelfmark to a loop at the end of 'n.d.:160:8:D'. Two thicker ditto-dash segments are visible under it, at about x 1020–1300 and x 1520–1640. The candidate gives three dash groups. This is corrected below as a probable reading. The shelfmark reads 'c. 469'; the second digit form is retained as uncertain. The fragment 'n.d.:160:8:D' visible at the left edge of the fol. 47 image is this same line seen across the gutter. It is not a separate record.

The note is represented. In the source the word rendered 'not' is written compactly and looks like 'nt'/'ut'. The candidate's literal 'not' is a reasonable reading, but it is flagged as uncertain. Its attachment to r004 remains unproven.

The two-line entry, with 'n.d.:210:16:D.' at right, is represented. The left-margin slash and the absence of a shelfmark are noted. The 'D.' visible at the left edge of the fol. 47 image is the end of this formula seen across the gutter, not a fol. 47 entry.
The interlinear insertion above 'Mathura…' (resembling 'rā', possibly written over an earlier stroke) is kept within r004 with its uncertainty retained.
